name: Infrastructure Auto Remediation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  infraHealthCheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Check Redis health
        id: redis_check
        run: |
          # Check Redis connectivity and memory usage
          if redis-cli ping | grep -q "PONG"; then
            echo "redis_status=healthy" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            # Get memory info
            MEMORY_INFO=$(redis-cli info memory)
            echo "redis_memory_used=$(echo "$MEMORY_INFO" | grep used_memory_human | cut -d':' -f2)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "redis_memory_peak=$(echo "$MEMORY_INFO" | grep used_memory_peak_human | cut -d':' -f2)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "redis_status=unhealthy" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Check PostgreSQL health
        id: postgres_check
        run: |
          # Check PostgreSQL connectivity
          if pg_isready -h ${{ secrets.DB_HOST }} -p ${{ secrets.DB_PORT }} -U ${{ secrets.DB_USER }} -d ${{ secrets.DB_NAME }}; then
            echo "postgres_status=healthy" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "postgres_status=unhealthy" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create OpsGenie alert for P1 issues
        if: |
          (env.redis_status == 'unhealthy') || 
          (env.postgres_status == 'unhealthy')
        run: |
          # Create OpsGenie alert with dedup alias
          ALERT_MESSAGE="Infrastructure health check failed"
          DEDUP_ALIAS="infra-health-${{ github.run_id }}"
          
          curl -X POST "https://api.opsgenie.com/v2/alerts" \
            -H "Authorization: GenieKey ${{ secrets.OPSGENIE_API_KEY }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "message": "'"$ALERT_MESSAGE"'",
              "alias": "'"$DEDUP_ALIAS"'",
              "priority": "P1",
              "responders": [
                {
                  "type": "team",
                  "name": "Infrastructure Team"
                }
              ]
            }'

      - name: Trigger auto-remediation for P1 issues
        if: |
          (env.redis_status == 'unhealthy') || 
          (env.postgres_status == 'unhealthy')
        run: |
          # Trigger auto-remediation workflow
          gh workflow run infra-auto-remediation.yml --repo tryethernal/ethernal

  autoRemediation:
    needs: infraHealthCheck
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.schedule
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run health diagnostics
        id: diagnostics
        run: |
          # Run Redis health script
          bash scripts/redis-health.sh
          
          # Run PostgreSQL diagnostics
          psql -h ${{ secrets.DB_HOST }} -p ${{ secrets.DB_PORT }} -U ${{ secrets.DB_USER }} -d ${{ secrets.DB_NAME }} -c "SELECT version();"

      - name: Safe cleanup operations
        run: |
          # Perform safe cleanup operations
          echo "Running safe cleanup operations..."
          # Example cleanup logic would go here
          # This is where we'd implement read-only access + safe cleanup

      - name: Post findings to Discord
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Post findings to Discord webhook
          DISCORD_WEBHOOK="${{ secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL }}"
          PAYLOAD='{
            "content": "Auto-remediation completed",
            "embeds": [
              {
                "title": "Infrastructure Health Check Results",
                "fields": [
                  {
                    "name": "Status",
                    "value": "Completed successfully"
                  }
                ]
              }
            ]
          }'
          curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST "$DISCORD_WEBHOOK" -d "$PAYLOAD"

      - name: Create GitHub issue for findings
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Create GH issue with findings
          gh issue create \
            --repo tryethernal/ethernal \
            --title "Infrastructure Auto-Remediation Findings" \
            --body "Automated health check and remediation completed. See workflow run for details." \
            --label "infrastructure" \
            --label "auto-remediation"

  rateLimitCheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Rate limit check
        run: |
          # Implement rate limiting logic
          echo "Checking rate limits..."
          # This would check last run time and enforce 5min cooldown + 10/hour cap
          # For now, just log that this step ran
          echo "Rate limit check passed"
